title: Police Rescue Family From HIGHLY Abusive Father
description:
On February 4th, 2024. Police responded to a hostile situation where a father RAN over his wife after finding out that he tried concealing m*th when he wanted to take their children out for breakfast.  She was concerned for the children's safety so she quickly stepped in to remove her kids, an argument then ensued which let to the man getting in his vehicle and ultimately striking the victim. The man fled the scene but was later apprehended during a traffic stop. Unfortunately, it wasn't on bodycam.

Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus.
